source_name: World Culinary Awards 2025 — Saudi Arabia (Riyadh nominees and winners)
coverage_note: World Culinary Awards 2025: read the two Saudi categories (Saudi Arabia's Best Restaurant, Saudi Arabia's Best Hotel Restaurant) on worldculinaryawards.com. National winner Saudi Arabia's Best Restaurant: TAKARA, Al Khobar (outside Riyadh, dropped). Nominees whose page entry gives no city (e.g. Café de L'esplanade, Cello, Tokyo Arabia, Khan Al Rayhan, Le Maschou without city, NOZOMI KSA) were not recorded because the source does not place them in Riyadh; Jeddah/Khobar/AlUla/Red Sea nominees dropped. Awards are decided by a public/industry vote; nominations are submitted by the venues. Paywall: no.
